crm_notes: Summary: Mneme ThreadBridge builds per-brand routing + agent assist for mid-market retail clients. Primary ask: reliable ticket/email summarization + auto-tagging that plugs into Zendesk macros/workflows.
Key constraints: must survive flash sales (10x baseline traffic), <200ms agent-facing latency for summary snippet, deterministic tags for downstream macros.
Model preferences: leaning open models for cost control but require quantized/dedicated serving or private for PII customers. Wants automatic fallback to smaller models during spikes.
Integration notes: Zendesk triggers -> Redwood API -> tags + summary -> push back to Zendesk via app. Also want ability to generate suggested macros and one-click macro insertion for agents.
Security: strict data residency for EU brands, SAML SSO for agent-facing UI, audit log entries for every inference (requester id + model version + latency + token usage).
Quote from CPO (call 2026-02-20): 'If summaries are inconsistent the agents revert to full read — so precision > recall for tags, and deterministic phrasing for macros.'
POC goals (short): accuracy of auto-tags vs human labels (target F1>0.85), summary helpfulness score >4/5 in agent study, sustain 1k RPS spikes with <5% error/drop.
Integration stubs: will provide three Zendesk brand sandboxes, a sample of 50k tickets for offline eval, and current tagging taxonomy (CSV).
Internal notes: high priority for Q2 pipeline; deal likely if SLOs and security answers acceptable. Procurement sensitivity to monthly commit vs pay-as-you-go.
Next asks: Redwood to provide sample JSON schema for tag inference outputs, recommended quantization/model candidates, and a spike-resilience runbook for POC.
Short-chop items (agent style): - Legal wants retention table - IT needs SAML metadata - SE needs sample latency test harness
use_case_summary: Primary: ticket/email summarization for agent inbox (short digest + actionables) + auto-tagging into Zendesk fields for macro triggers and routing. Secondary: suggested macros and categorical routing to product queues.
technical_requirements: Throughput: sustain baseline 100 RPS, handle bursts to 1k RPS for up to 10 minutes
Cost sensitivity: mid-high; prefer dedicated pools or quantized models to control per-token spend
Model behavior: deterministic tag output, structured JSON for macros, customizable prompt templates per brand
Fallbacks: automatic route to compact model variant on capacity or degraded network, preserve tag schema compatibility
Observability: token-level cost, per-request trace id, per-model quality metrics stored for rollback decisions
po_c_details: POC ask: 6 weeks. Phase 1 (2w): offline eval on 50k tickets, tag model + baseline. Phase 2 (2w): Zendesk sandbox integration, real-time inference. Phase 3 (2w): spike test + agent UX study. Success criteria: F1>0.85 tags, agent helpfulness >4, spike resilience validated.
